critical_code_review_comments: RichEditor.jsx line 20: setContent is only applied when !editor.isFocused — fine for typical use, but if a parent updates `value` while the editor is focused, the editor stays stale. Low priority.
html.js toSafeHtml: isHtml regex is permissive; combined with DOMPurify this is safe. OK.
server.py snippet() strips HTML via regex (good enough for current data); for extremely large content it is O(n) — acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (theme, editor create/edit, sheets, XSS, plain-text, branding, print)

seed_data_creation: All test data (TEST_rich_ui course, TEST_sheet_ui sheet, TEST_xss_ui, TEST_plain_ui, TEST_qcm_ui, TEST_print quiz) created during tests and cleaned up. A leftover TEST_rich_ui course (id a9b92f0b-54fb-4eb2-ae52-aff882c885ee) from an earlier run was also deleted via API. The persistent fixture course 50fc2003 remained unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter3 added TipTap rich editor + dark mode + Medbook rename. Rich editor testid pattern: `${kind}-content-editor-content` for contenteditable zone, `${kind}-content-editor-{bold,italic,underline,h2,h3,bullet,ordered,quote,hr,clear,undo,redo}` for toolbar buttons. Use mousedown-preventDefault pattern (buttons work via onMouseDown). After clicking the editable area, use page.keyboard.type. Theme toggle: data-testid='theme-toggle', storage key 'medbook_theme'. Admin selector `[data-testid^='admin-courses-']` matches the panel too — filter by '-' + uuid regex instead. Module Ue 5 id eeef84b2-146c-4c0c-91e7-226ae7a907b0 and course 50fc2003 are kept as fixtures.
